notes.title: Beautiful new 2D Metroidvania Fallen Tear The Ascension sets release window
notes.notes:
From Prince of Persia: The Lost Crown to Nine Sols, Animal Well, and many more besides, we've been spoiled by great Metroidvania games in recent years. Making a fresh appearance at today's OTK Games Expo, Fallen Tear: The Ascension is an upcoming action platformer that's very much caught my eye. Boasting absolutely beautiful 2D art design, a giant world inspired by Elden Ring and Breath of the Wild, a clever JRPG-style party system providing mid-combat assists, and a soundtrack crafted by Dark Souls composer Motoi Sakuraba, this is one for your Steam wishlist.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: March Week 1 Developer Update: Animation
notes.notes:
3 months into 2023 and we got a bunch of animation updates for you!!
Anyone a fan of Avatar the Last Airbender? These animations may be a treat for you ːsteamhappyː 


Early in January, we worked on our punch animations! This time we paired it up with 4 different elements, namely, fire, water, air, earth. Our team tried to give distinct personalities to each element so it expresses different feels to impacts.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39731856/6c7ee5107167f7faf4016b830a8755a985b215ee.gif[/img]

Into February, just like our elemental punches, we also finalized our meteor stomp animations! You can see them in action down below! Hira sure knows how to pack a punch!!

notes.title: Concept Demo Update - JP VER. now available!
notes.notes:
[h1]DEMO JP VER. UPDATE[/h1]

22人の仲間たちとのキズナを描くメトロイドヴァニア系2Dアクション――
『Fallen Tear : The Ascension』の体験版が日本語に対応しました！

日本語でプレイするためには、起動後、Options→Languageから日本語を選択してください。

この体験版では、戦闘、探索、成長システム、仲間とのキズナなどの基本的な要素を体験できます。ストーリーやステージなどは体験版専用のものとなっており、現在開発中の本編とは異なりますのでご注意ください。

体験版を気に入っていただけた方は、ウィッシュリストへの登録をお願いします！

そして今後の情報をお楽しみに！
* [url=http://fallentearascension.com]Website[/url]
* [url=https://twitter.com/FallenTearGame]Twitter[/url]
* [url=https://www.facebook.com/fallenteargame]Facebook[/url]
* [url=https://www.instagram.com/fallenteargame/]Instagram[/url]

[h1]OTHER ADJUSTMENTS[/h1]

This update also includes several bugfixes and some minor adjustments to game feel, such as the jump height and speed. We've these changes after receiving feedback from our players.

[h1]PLEASE SUPPORT US AND SIGN UP![/h1]

[url=http://fallentearascension.com][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39731856/d7587f6d9418ce2f70fdeaee2c7e55dbc6a6f88f.jpg[/img][/url]

If you STILL have not signed up for our email newsletter, please consider doing so! 

The game is still in early development, so we still have focus tests, closed betas, news updates, promos and other features on the horizon. Joining the newsletter puts you on a shortlist for participation, as we did previously with our 0.1.0 limited early concept demos.

[url=https://discord.com/invite/NBPAF3Mvv9][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39731856/025effea8a2a20a4d8647c097865a0e096649a6e.jpg[/img][/url]

We also suggest joining our official discord channel to send feedback, talk with the devs, mingle with other players and meet members of the community. We are very interested to hear from you, and your feedback helps us shape the game!

Once again, thank you for supporting Fallen Tear: The Ascension!
